notes:
Mid-market B2B SaaS (productivity suite) evaluating Redwood to replace mixed OpenAI + Anthropic stack. Primary drivers: lower per-token cost at scale, deterministic latency, and better rollout controls for model variants. Team wants hosted API for quick POC and then a migration to Dedicated for predictable throughput and data isolation once prompt parity verified. They emphasized: 'We need identical responses for top-5 critical prompts or a documented regression path.'

POC scope agreed: 2-week hosted trial using Redwood's gptx-compat variant + parity harness provided by SE. Focus on support-agent flows (multi-turn chat), document search embeddings for 1.2M docs, and a code-assist endpoint for internal dev tools. Latency target: p95 < 220ms for single-turn chat; throughput: 150 reqs/min sustained for peak working hours. Cost sensitivity: target 30-40% token cost reduction compared to current blended provider spend.

Security: require SSO/SAML, KMS integration for key management, audit logs retention 1 year, and EU data residency for subset of accounts. Legal asked for SOC2 artifact prior to Dedicated contract. Team comfortable with hosted for initial eval but will require VPC/dedicated network path before go-live.

SE notes: parity harness found ~6% top-level regression on summarization prompts out-of-box; SE proposed prompt templates + small eval set to track regressions. Suggested using Redwood Optimize recommendations (quant profiles + batching) to reach target cost.

Customer quote from kickoff: 'Hosted POC is a must — but we won't flip to Dedicated until prompt parity and cost math are explicit.'

Cost on hosted was ~28% lower in baseline runs; with batching/quant suggestions expect additional savings. SE recommends dedicated pilot to stabilize latency and reduce variance.

migration_plan: Step 1: Hosted POC with compat harness and eval set. Step 2: Run a parallel staging migration of embedding index (re-ingest subset). Step 3: Small Dedicated pilot (one GPU pool) with canary traffic. Step 4: Full cutover + rollback playbook. Estimated migration effort: 6-8 weeks excluding legal.
